bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Centrifuge V3 supports native burn-and-mint share bridging between EVM networks through Spoke. The Pharos route binds the Ethereum pool/share class through Centrifuge Spoke and its configured LayerZero and Chainlink CCIP transports; signer, cap and incident claims remain unresolved. The bridge guide explicitly excludes Solana and Stellar as target networks, so the Solana mint's transfer architecture remains unresolved despite verified mint and freeze authorities.

routes.protocol: Centrifuge Solana share deployment (transfer architecture unresolved)
routes.reviewNote: Official Centrifuge deployment registry identifies this mint, but the EVM share bridge guide excludes Solana targets. Finalized joint mint/authority/multisig observation at slot 452524950 (2026-10-02; block hash 4zyMTBniC7n4tmKLK47FbBiUpCARjvZ6qk2J26goge8c) confirms Token-2022, 6 decimals, zero supply, default-frozen accounts, and mint/freeze/permanent-delegate/metadata-update authority 3JiU6sJt94WcD6r7EFTUnJo6By9DJ9WJxovRGfY9oseb. Although its account is System-owned with no data, that authority is an off-curve Squads v4 vault PDA (index 0, bump 255) of multisig F8uKD1uQ4o2NVizM8VfNvBMNoL18WXXbhTjKqfzvBTSX. The multisig is owned by SQDS4ep65T869zMMBKyuUq6aD6EgTu8psMjkvj52pCf, has threshold 2, eight members but only six Vote-enabled signers, zero timelock and zero config authority; signer independence is unknown. Seven returned mint-history transactions include creation and authority transfers from Eg37TXi7ojfPT4kQPFUu6umtvz3cCN2Xif5TgQKDd68C, with no mint/burn instruction. Metadata-pointer authority remains Eg37. This proves control capability, not a current issuer-native liability accounting or Ethereum-to-Solana transfer path; those semantics remain unresolved. Wave-2 diagnostic census by Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (W2L18Secured), observed 2026-10-09T11:52:43Z: one atomic finalized getMultipleAccounts response from https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com has context slot 454858260, joined to that exact finalized slot's getBlock hash Hjv9jAhg5cVj42G2seueWvFCwHZsWGS11zYjxCZWv1dB and block timestamp 2026-10-09T11:52:15Z. This new response again has zero raw supply, six decimals, the same four extensions and recorded authorities; no transfer-hook or confidential-mint extension is returned. Its Squads bytes decode under the cited af94153 layout to threshold 2, eight members, six Vote-enabled, six Execute-enabled and seven Initiate-enabled members, zero timelock, zero config authority, transaction index 58 and stale index 50. The endpoint's response context slot is the observation pin; minContextSlot 452524950 was only a lower bound, not a requested historical pin. Solana's permanent-delegate specification permits transfer or burn from any account for this mint and holders cannot revoke that delegate. No deployed-program runtime/source match, exhaustive reachable execution certificate, holder-liability/legal burn mapping or negative incident census is established, so capAuthority, claimImpairment, incidentState and route architecture remain unresolved. This direct keyless read is diagnostic source recovery because the supplemental Dwellir helper has no Solana method; it is not a helper-admitted execution certificate or a production supply-attribution packet.

routes.protocol: Centrifuge V3 spoke messaging (LayerZero and Chainlink CCIP)
routes.reviewNote: Review jtrsy-pharos-route-20261104. Lead-supplied number-pinned reads at Pharos block 22133080 (0x151b958), bracketed by matching hash 0x6e2fb16cbc6eb5fb1a58737eaaef3678a1623491b298e3018aae4f3d46ced03a, bind Spoke shareTokenDetails(token) to poolId 0x0001000000000006 and scId 0x00010000000000060000000000000001, with the reverse shareToken(poolId,scId) returning this exact JTRSY token. PoolId encodes Ethereum hub centrifugeId 1; localCentrifugeId is 12. The observed Spoke gateway 0x19a524d03aa94ecee41a80341537bcfcb47d3172 binds MultiAdapter 0x35c837f0a54b715a23d193e1476bfc9bc30073be, whose pool adapter count is 2: LayerZero 0xd517bc7ba17271a8d87be7355b2523bf5c750295 and Chainlink CCIP 0x39cf679eb0ac9075cfb5f94930a367ba1557d955. quorum=2 is the adapter count, not a verified confirmation threshold; threshold and recoveryIndex were not supplied. Release-pinned Spoke/HubHandler source burns origin shares, transfers equal hub per-chain issuance, and mints destination shares: burn/mint, not escrow-backed lock/mint. Earlier block 22124683 independently binds token runtime, six decimals and wards(Spoke)=1. This is the provider rail, consistent with ACRDX spoke routes; it does not establish signer independence, caps, active transport security configuration or no-known-incident. Content-addressed source observations and exact provenance are retained in the Worker infrastructure appendix review record. Source observations: source:baa2cb8d0e6ee8d8cc92b5e6, source:3df61c28982ee3dce6edf6b3, source:11403f1b15fc3d9a25e82a6b.

oracleRisk.summary: JTRSY is an Anemoy fund share on Centrifuge. Centrifuge documents issuer-set primary NAV at the Hub, manager-published share prices, and separate batch execution prices for subscriptions/redemptions. Chronicle verification is an additional layer; its presence does not establish independent authority over the fund valuation or execution price. This review classifies the documented fund-level pricing authority, not current updater keys, relay topology, or signer independence.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Pharos NAV-parity B1-b primary-source pricing review
branchApplicability.rationale: JTRSY represents a managed fund share whose subscription/redemption conversion uses fund valuation. This top-level NAV authority remains applicable without borrower collateral or liquidation branches. Downstream lending integrations are not the fund share pricing mechanism.
